De las bibliotecas que ya configuraste e: From the libraries you already configured in KiCad. If a part is not there, the chat does not draw an invented symbol.
¿Y si el símbolo no trae huella?: What if the symbol has no footprint?

Sí, por proyecto, junto a los ajustes. O: Yes, per project, next to the settings. Another project does not see them. The chat uses them as a read-only summary: they do not reopen the conversation or undo what was done. They do not store the API key.
¿Por qué hay que cerrar el editor de esq: Why does the schematic editor have to be closed?
KiCad 10 no deja escribir el esquemático: KiCad 10 does not allow writing the schematic through the API. The plugin edits the `.kicad_sch` and keeps a copy in `.kicad-ia-backup/`. With the editor open, it does not write.

¿Colocar la placa certifica el diseño?: Does placing the board certify the design?
No. El informe es un prechequeo IPC Clas: No. The report is an IPC Class 2 pre-check. Validate only fixes what it can do safely.
